items.heading: Explains the first coupling of the look of the eyes in AHP, from which the vessels of the head came about, and the second coupling of the look, from which the vessels of the body came about. It contains eight matters: — 1. From the light of the look in the breaths of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, which are phase four, phase three, and phase two, the vessels came about. 2. "And God saw": this is the secret of the look. "Et": this is Nefesh. "The light": this is Ruach and Neshama. "And He separated": He made the vessels, which is the secret of separation and boundary. 3. In the look there is direct light and reflected light, for when the direct light expanded to the screen upon Malchut, the screen returned the light upward, and the light that returned clothed the direct light from below upward. 4. At the beginning of the expansion of the direct light for the coupling by striking on the screen in Malchut, it made only the phase of the roots of vessels for the head. 5. To make the vessels of the body, a second look is needed on the screen in the mouth, which is Malchut. 6. In the ten Sefirot of the look, which are direct light, the root, which is Keter, came out close to the eye, and HB TM expand from the eye downward to the Yesod close to the mouth. 7. In reflected light, the root, which is Keter, came out close to the mouth, which is Malchut, which is the root of the reflected light; and HB TM expand and rise from the mouth upward, to the Malchut of the reflected light that comes close to the eye, and clothe the ten Sefirot of direct light. 8. The ten Sefirot of reflected light, when included in the ten Sefirot of direct light, make the level of all the vessels equal. — From the light of the look in the breaths of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, which are phase four, phase three, and phase two, the vessels came about
items.html: One needs to understand what is the matter of this sight and this look of the eyes. Know that the sight of the eyes 1drew from it a look at Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshama mentioned above, and because of its looking at them, the vessels came about. This is the secret of "And God saw the light, that it was good, and He separated," etc., for 2Ruach and Neshama are called light, and Nefesh is called "et," as is known, for Nefesh is Malchut and is called "et."

items.heading: "And God saw": this is the secret of the look. "Et": this is Nefesh. "The light": this is Ruach and Neshama. "And He separated": He made the vessels, which is the secret of separation and boundary
items.html: It follows that in the look of His sight, may He be blessed, at "et" "the light," which is the Nefesh called 3"et," and the Ruach and Neshama called light, then the vessels came out, which are those that separate and make separation, boundary, and measure in the lights, as is known, and this is "And He separated."

items.heading: In the look there is direct light and reflected light, for when the direct light expanded to the screen upon Malchut, the screen returned the light upward, and the light that returned clothed the direct light from below upward
items.html: 4And know that in this look there are two phases, and they are: direct light from above downward, and reflected light from below upward. For at first the sight was drawn from above, to the end of the tenth, lowest phase of the Nefesh, and afterward, when the light returned from below upward, then the separating vessels were made and came about and clothed the Nefesh in all its parts, from below upward. And see above, in the preceding discourse (brought here below shortly, at item 6), for there this matter of the look was explained well, and how the vessels were made from below upward; see there well.

items.heading: At the beginning of the expansion of the direct light for the coupling by striking on the screen in Malchut, it made only the phase of the roots of vessels for the head
items.html: And know that this direct light had the power to make 5vessels for the phase of the head, but nevertheless its matter was not recognizable until this look struck the light of the Nefesh of the mouth, as mentioned, 6and through this the phase of the vessels of the head became recognizable.

items.heading: To make the vessels of the body, a second look is needed on the screen in the mouth, which is Malchut
items.html: But 7the phase of the vessels of the body, which are the seven lower ones, could not be made by the straight light of the aforementioned look alone, until the look observed and struck the light of the Nefesh of the mouth, 8and through both of these, the light returned from below upward and made vessels, and clothed the seven lower ones called the body.

items.heading: In the ten Sefirot of the look, which are direct light, the root, which is Keter, came out close to the eye. And HB TM expand from the eye downward to the Yesod close to the mouth
items.html: *Indeed, of the ten Sefirot in the look, whichever is more attached to its root is higher, for Keter is the closest and nearest to the eye of all the rest, and so on for the rest in this manner.

items.heading: In reflected light, the root, which is Keter, came out close to the mouth, which is Malchut, which is the root of the reflected light. And HB TM expand and rise from the mouth upward, to the Malchut of the reflected light that comes close to the eye, and clothe the ten Sefirot of direct light. The ten Sefirot of reflected light, when included in the ten Sefirot of direct light, make the level of all the vessels equal
items.html: 9Indeed, the phase of Malchut came out first, 10and when the light strikes and returns, then the entire phase of the vessels was equal, 20such that if the Yesod had expanded before it more than the Malchut, it would be equal to the Malchut even though it is Yesod (since it expanded more), because the Yesod, 30owing to the abundance of the light of the Malchut, had the power to expand more; 40yet it has no advantage over the Malchut, but rather because this expansion is in the phase of reflected light, which returns and draws close to its source; however, in the phase of the vessels themselves, they are equal. 50And when the light returns and clothes the breath, it follows that when it is close to the mouth, then the light of the mouth is greater there than the light of the ear, because 60the breath of the mouth, being here, is in the phase of the head, 70but the breath of the ear, being here, is still in the phase of the rest of the body.
